findings.title: bad_tree_mode test vector declares 30 bytes for a 35-byte cat-file payload, reaching truncation rather than the non-digit mode guard in _parse_tree_task_numbers

summary: Independent implementation review REV-0003 (stage implementation) APPROVE for TASK-0155 (base b489233a26c31e193929c5d1973eae36571ba058, subject 86f3c053afe051fae39e4372a18bf458a0236e5d). Verified strict allowed_scope containment (7 source/test files plus .ai/tasks/TASK-0155/**), AST identity of gate._v2_gate_facts (MUT-V2-004 untouched), task_numbers_in_refs batching via for-each-ref plus cat-file --batch raw binary tree parsing (<= 2 git calls, empty/missing/dedup handling, GIT_TASK_REFS_UNAVAILABLE fail-closed guards), single-pass porcelain-v2 worktree_scope_paths reuse across scope.py/gate.py/status_service.py without extra git status calls, commits_are_ancestral short-circuiting with SHA validation preserved, and status_service/gate parity across StatusSummary.classification digest freshness, _merge_readiness policy/repository/scope readiness, pure_guard-safe native V2 facts inside _current_facts, _evidence_status pre_implementation_review precedence, and live _approval_status evidence_current binding. Confirmed cleanliness (no host usernames or absolute paths), full V1 verification evidence (6527 passed, 94% core diff coverage, ruff/mypy/contract/scope clean), and independent execution of the 7 targeted test suites (408 passed, 1 skipped). One non-blocking low finding noted in tests/unit/test_git_context.py where bad_tree_mode specifies size 30 for a 35-byte payload.
